snippet.title: Speedway Bundle: Stock & Truck - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
While the bundle does give you both separate games on Xbox One and Microsoft Store like it should do, it seems Super PowerUp Games had some problems(?) making the bundle work the same way on PlayStation Store. As such, this is a standalone game on PS4/5, complete with its own trophy list.

This bundle contains Speedway Racing and Speed Truck Racing.

Developed by Super PowerUp Games
Also released on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch
